text_blocks.snippet: Pfizer's oral antiviral medication for COVID-19 is called Paxlovid. It's a pill that can be taken at home to reduce the risk of severe illness in high-risk individuals who contract COVID-19. Specifically, it's for those 12 and older (weighing at least 88 pounds) with mild to moderate COVID-19 who are at high risk of their infection becoming more severe. Paxlovid needs to be taken within the first five days of experiencing symptoms.
